rationale: The short thesis remains intact as NKE continues to trade in the bottom 4.4% of its daily range on 3.51x relative volume, well below both session VWAP ($38.81) and the descending 5-minute 9-EMA ($37.47). The recent bounce from near the $37.16 session low has occurred on relatively light 1-minute volume and has not breached the 9-EMA or the $37.70 invalidation level, while broad market weakness (SPY -1.16%, VIXY +6.13%) continues to support a breakdown through the lows.
